intended_object: The projection (evaluation) functor ∏_{i∈I} C_i → C_i at a fixed index i. It sends a family of objects (X_j) to X_i and a family of morphisms (f_j) to f_i. This comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body sends an object f to f i and a morphism α to α i. In the product category `∀ i, C i`, morphisms are componentwise families, so this is exactly the i-th projection functor. The functor laws hold definitionally. The setting is already fully general: an arbitrary index type I, an arbitrary family of categories, and arbitrary universes. This is Mathlib's own canonical definition of this functor, so no other Mathlib declaration plays the role of a counterpart.
